name: Antigravity CLI
description: Google's Antigravity agent CLI (binary agy), installed with its official bootstrapper, which checks a sha512 from the release manifest.
install: rm -f {{prefix}}/bin/agy; t=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh -o "$t" && bash "$t" --dir {{prefix}}/bin; rc=$?; rm -f "$t"; exit $rc
upgrade: rm -f {{prefix}}/bin/agy; t=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh -o "$t" && bash "$t" --dir {{prefix}}/bin; rc=$?; rm -f "$t"; exit $rc
